evidence: Modifies package validation internals in `src/validation.cpp` to support package feerate calculation and sibling eviction during dry-run acceptance.
rationale: Extends mempool package acceptance machinery to support dry-run evaluation of 1p1c bundles and sibling eviction without mempool mutation. While valuable for testing policy acceptance, it exposes dry-run validation rather than altering policy rules or solving DoS pinning issues directly.
